deviation: The draft lowers the availability commitment to 99.0%, below both the 99.9% standard and the 99.5% fallback, and removes service credits entirely. Arcadia would have no financial remedy for outages, and the SLA would be unenforceable in practice.
suggested_text: The Supplier shall achieve at least 99.9% availability each month and shall issue service credits of 5% of monthly fees for each full 1% shortfall.
